consent.title: Instagram Use Study
consent.intro: You are about to start the process of donating information about your Instagram use to our study. The data that we ask you to donate will be used for academic research to gain insight into social media use and wellbeing. Only counts are extracted: for each day, how many posts and videos you viewed, ads you saw or clicked, things you liked, commented on, saved or published, searches you made, accounts you followed, new followers, and messages you sent and received, plus the interest topics Instagram assigned to you. The content itself is never read or transmitted: no usernames or names of other people, no links, no message or comment text, no captions, photos or videos, no search terms, no locations, and no login or device information.
consent.process: We will walk you through this process step by step. During this process no data is stored or sent to a server. You can filter by date and delete rows from the data before donating. Data will only be donated and stored when you click the button "Yes, donate" on the page that shows your data.
agreementPoints: you fully and voluntarily agree to donate your data for this research.
you are aware that when your data is used for academic publications, or made publicly available in some other form, this will be anonymous.
you are aware that you have the right to withdraw your permission.
consent.agreementCheckbox: I have read and agree with the above terms.

upload.title: Upload File
upload.intro: Please request a copy of your Instagram data: in the Instagram app go to your profile → menu (☰) → Accounts Center → Your information and permissions → Download your information → Download or transfer information. Choose your Instagram account, select "All available information" (or at least "Your activity", "Ads information" and "Connections"), choose "Download to device", set the date range to "All time", and importantly set Format to "JSON" (not HTML). Meta will notify you when the file is ready, usually within a day. Download the .zip file and upload it here without unpacking it. If your export came as several .zip files, upload the first one.
upload.processing: Processing your file... This may take a few moments for large exports.
upload.incorrectFile: The uploaded file might be incorrect, in HTML format, or void of Instagram activity.
upload.possibleIssues: We were unable to find any recognizable Instagram activity in the uploaded file. This could mean:
issuePoints: The export was made in HTML format instead of JSON (please request a new export and choose JSON)
The file is a Facebook export rather than an Instagram export
Your export was split into several .zip files and this part contains only media
The file is corrupted or incomplete
upload.checkFile: Please check that you have uploaded the Instagram export .zip in JSON format or contact the researchers for assistance.
upload.note: Note: The process to extract the correct data from the file is done on your own computer. No data is stored or sent yet. Extraction may take a while for large exports.

filter.intro: Determine whether you would like to donate the data below. Carefully check the data and adjust when required. You can filter by date range and delete rows. With your donation you contribute to the previously described research. Thank you in advance.
filter.donationPrompt: Do you want to donate the above data?
filter.note: Note: Sending the data may take several seconds depending on the data size.

thankyou.title: Thank You!
thankyou.successMessage: Your data has been successfully submitted. Thank you for your contribution!
thankyou.saveId: Please save this ID for your records.
thankyou.declineMessage: Thank you for your time. Your decision has been recorded and no data has been shared.
